{{Locations|Civilian Sector|Slug Controlled Nebula|Slug Home Nebula|plasmastorm=true|alsooccur=nebulafiller|LRSmap=noship+plasmastorm|unique=true}}


''You find two heavily damaged ships floating nearby, the remains of a battle. You begin to harvest some usable debris when you hear the sounds of someone beaming aboard followed by the shouts of a boarding party.''
*You receive medium [[Rewards#Standard|scrap with resources]], and <span style="color:red">3-4 human boarders</span> beam aboard your ship.

==Notes==
This event is called "STORM_BOARDING" in the datafiles.
* In Slug sectors this event can occur in a non-nebula area of the beacon map. In that case the event will still have a plasma storm nebula environment, but the Fleet pursuit will be the full amount (instead of the 80% that you would have when jumping from a nebula beacon in a Slug sector).
[[Category:Boarding hazard]]
